title: FINAL RUSH HUD CLEARANCE
why: The critic found the final rush crowded by the clock, score and extraction arrow. During the two player demo rush the clock and score stay in separate windows with a 16px gap, the smaller score gets a solid backing, and extraction moves beside the clock. The rush panel is at least 416px wide with a 16px inset and 24px clearance. Playtest watch: check both windows at 1:30 for readable navigation and a clear rush banner; all scoring and wave timings stay as shipped in v35.83.
now: The final rush banner has more space, a wide graphite panel and clear red title. The smaller score stays below the larger clock; extraction sits beside the clock during the rush.
